rule: Targets and commits change only with a new benchmark version.

targets.notes: Test deps are the `tests` dependency group in pyproject.toml. Version comes from hatch-vcs; the fresh history has no tags, so the version is pretended, as attrs' own tox.ini allows. Suite at this commit: 1405 passed, 6 skipped, 1 xfailed. src/ layout: an install of the user's copy makes the shadow's checks import the user's files, not the shadow's (product finding), so the harness installs attrs non-editable, for its metadata, and puts the shadow's src/ first on PYTHONPATH.
No toolchain file (rust-version 1.85), so the benchmark's 1.99.1. Default features. Suite at this commit: 183 passed (cargo nextest run).

Test deps from [tool.poetry.dev-dependencies]: pytest (pinned by proob) and attrs; the rest are lint and coverage tools. Pygments is pinned to poetry.lock's 2.19.2: with the newest (2.21.0) 8 syntax-highlighting snapshot tests fail at this commit; with 2.19.2 the suite passes (956 passed, 25 skipped).

system_deps: openssl 3 (Homebrew openssl@3; openssl-sys finds it without pkg-config)
targets.notes: rust-toolchain.toml pins 1.99.1. build.rs refuses to compile without a DB backend feature; `sqlite` bundles SQLite (libsqlite3-sys/bundled), so OpenSSL is the only system library. proob's Rust adapter has no way to pass cargo features, so the harness passes none: enabling the feature is left to the agent, inside the shadow, as a new user would have to.
